title: audit: action-invocation, data-export and dataset-query rows record only performedBy.clientId for in-product AI calls
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: two out-of-scope findings from the final report 6933914884 of card #33694 (PR #34547), passed on by area `o2-B`. One collector card for the family, with an enumeration. Dedupe: `performedBy clientId audit`, `hook-bodies.mdx performedBy`; no open card.

reach: a named producer. When an in-product AI runs an action, exports data or queries a dataset, the audit writers record only `performedBy.clientId` (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/action-invocation-audit.ts` line ~159, and the data-export and dataset-query writers). Re-check with `grep -n "performedBy" packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/*.ts`.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:server` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #33694 (reuse the keys and the stamping it lands)

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#33694 让 `sys_audit_log` 里产品内 AI 的写入带上会话 id 和确认 id。另外三类审计行(动作调用、数据导出、数据集查询)仍然只记 `clientId`,查不到是哪次 AI 会话、哪次确认触发的。文档 `hook-bodies.mdx` 的表格也只列了 `clientId`。
- 为什么要修：管理员追查「AI 做了什么、谁同意的」时，只有一类审计行能答上来，另外三类答不上来。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Enumeration (each one ticked in the fixing PR)

- [ ] action-invocation audit row
- [ ] data-export audit row
- [ ] dataset-query audit row
- [ ] `hook-bodies.mdx`: the `performedBy` table lists `performedByConversationId` and `performedByConfirmationId` beside `clientId`

## Change

After PR #34547 merges, stamp the same `conversation_id` / `confirmation_id` metadata on the three rows through the helper #33694 lands, not a second copy. Pin each one with a test that an AI-performed call writes both ids.

## Done when

All four boxes are ticked and the three pin tests pass.

Blocked-by: #33694
